identifiers.identifier_scope: Alnuctamab is identified by its development code CC-93269.

mechanism_of_action.plain_language: Alnuctamab is a bispecific antibody that targets both BCMA on multiple myeloma cells and CD3 on T cells, facilitating T cell-mediated killing of the cancer cells.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: Bispecific binding to BCMA and CD3, leading to T cell activation and cytotoxicity against BCMA-expressing cells.

data_notes.record_scope: This record is focused on the investigational agent Alnuctamab, primarily in the context of its use in multiple myeloma.
